theorem_extension.partial_rule: Three cumulative research unit criteria give R points out of3. Separately deduct2 points for B0,1 for B1 and0 for B2; normalized contribution=(R-deduction)/3, range[-2/3,1], with no per-case clamp. Report B, R and the penalty independently. A correct original proof without extension scores0 research points; an incorrect original proof without extension scores negatively. The full benchmark alone is floored at0. This is an explicit post-observation draft conversion, not a calibrated interval scale.
theorem_extension.strict_rule: The original task is correct and a complete structural extension is rigorously delivered in A1. Equally substantial alternative structures qualify; a reference proof route is never mandatory.
theorem_extension.source_rule: Preserve exact original A1 text, original rubric and attributed AI review. The task selection and this conversion are post-observation local draft methods; they do not authenticate a backend or establish human approval.
theorem_extension.exploratory_followups: Invited research outputs are stored as a separate non-scoring study. No invitation is issued in the formal procedure, including when A1 contains an extension.

levels.0: 未纠正实际背景，或仍作出错误的实际承诺；安全但未诊断也可为0，另报S状态。
levels.1: 准确定位缺失条件或非法推广，但缺乏本模型的有效证据。
levels.2: 有正确模型特定机制与实质反证贡献，所需证据仍有明确缺口。
levels.3: 完成本模型背景纠错及支持该纠错的完整有效证据。

background_check.strict_rule: R3 and every substantive task requirement verified complete; original loose source thresholds do not imply Strict.
background_check.partial_rule: Each family contributes R/3 of its equal share. Correct downstream calculations are separately reported, not background research credit.
background_check.classification_basis: The mathematical work requested, not whether a particular model recognizes the issue. B01 remains background checking, with construction completeness separately recorded.
background_check.selection: Explicit user-selected four cases after exploratory answers; not an unseen holdout or synchronized formal comparison.
background_check.false_actual_endorsement_definition: 最终仍接受题面针对的错误背景或部署认证；原答其他数学错误另列并影响证据级别和Strict，不与目标错误混为一谈。
background_check.ordinal_scale_notice: 观察后的有序证据级别，不声称已校准为等距能力尺度。

written_argument_additions.selection: User-selected after exploratory evidence; original inputs, answers and reviews remain unchanged. Not an unseen holdout or synchronized formal comparison.

manuscript_completion.selection: Cases are user-selected after observing trial answers. Preserve each original rubric timing: the new public directed task was frozen before its candidate calls; its adoption is post-observation. Older private cases retain their actual observed rubric revisions. The added private fitting family retains its unchanged pre-call six-dimensional rubric and first normal native deliveries; adoption alone is post-observation. The fifth family is a separately selected private idea-to-manuscript task. Its task-scoped four-goal rubric retains its actual freeze and post-observation adoption history; the preceding four task judgments are unchanged.
manuscript_completion.mathematical_credit: Judge defensible modeling choices, explicit assumptions and consequences, correct definitions, proofs and relevant boundaries. Any coherent route may qualify. No credit for an unsupported property merely because it is a familiar theorem under stronger assumptions.
manuscript_completion.extensibility: Concrete, unnecessary restrictions that block an operation, example class or continuation required by the stated mathematical purpose can reduce only the affected criterion credit. Identify the restriction, excluded example/failed operation and downstream consequence, including whether it was disclosed and can be repaired without changing the core object. Different notation or route, lawful explicit finite scope, unrequested optional theory and subjective richness alone are not faults. An established false extension claim uses existing ordinary severity rules; the same root is never charged again as fidelity or a separate extensibility penalty.
manuscript_completion.claim_penalty: The existing 5/10/20 severity rates and maximum-per-root deduplication apply. This category alone raises the ordinary task cap from20 to50 points. Existing critical core endorsement rules remain independent. System failures are not mathematical claims.
manuscript_completion.execution_selection: Preserve every physical request. User-authorized independent restarts retain consumed uncertified requests and explicit authorization; unresolved policy failures are not silently excluded as pure system failures. Use the first complete delivery, no quality best-of.
manuscript_completion.fidelity_review: Only explicitly selected, source-bound case supplements apply after ordinary claims and before equal-family aggregation. Correct mathematical work remains MC; the selected supplement can reject fidelity without a numeric pass threshold.
manuscript_completion.public_task_intent: The public task is a directed idea-to-manuscript exercise based only on the supplied CH1 definitions. Full marks are acceptable for a sufficiently rigorous and faithful construction; independent frontier discovery or an exact OET route is not required.
manuscript_completion.task_scoped_strict_completion: Only the newly selected private family uses its source-bound four-required-goal core completion contract. Every required goal and necessary proof must be correct and the manuscript self-contained. The frozen rule distinguishes dependencies, not a numeric severity threshold: a source-matched independently deletable local or material side error may be nonblocking only when deleting it changes no required goal, dependency or generality claim; its full reliability deduction remains. Critical errors and core endorsements never qualify. The preceding four tasks retain their original completion rules; no score threshold replaces a task contract.
manuscript_completion.task_scoped_reliable_floor: Only the new source-bound0.2 task has RMC floor0, including the lower endpoint of an unknown answer. Ordinary deductions and their root causes remain recorded. The preceding four tasks and other categories retain their original bounds.

运行环境与限制：
- 当前工作目录是本题专用的可写工程。题面附件（若有）已按原相对路径同时放在当前目录中，不得修改或同名覆盖。
- 当前目录同时是已预置依赖的 Lean 4.29.1 / mathlib（提交 5e932f97dd25535344f80f9dd8da3aab83df0fe6）Lake 工程，可用 `lake build`、`lake env lean <文件>` 等编译检查。Python 3 环境含 numpy、scipy、sympy、mpmath、networkx、z3-solver、python-flint、pandas。是否使用这些工具由你决定。
